REASINGS_H.scope: The include guard: a Bend import loads the module once.

REASINGS_STATIC_INLINE.scope: Inline linkage: every top-level Bend definition is visible to importers.

EASEDEF.scope: static inline or extern linkage: every top-level Bend definition is visible to importers.

PI.scope: reasings' fallback PI (3.14159265358979323846f) is Jonmath's F32 PI, the same float.
